description: Everyone who works for this merchant — Manage → Team → Users. Answers 'who works here', 'what role does Maria have', 'who can see reports', 'what is Tom's phone number'. This is about who works here and what they are allowed to do — for how much anyone SOLD, use get_employee_sales instead. Returns the whole team at once: there is no search and no paging, so filter the rows yourself instead of asking the merchant to narrow down. Removed people are not listed at all. Every other tool in this domain takes its userId from here.
name: hub_get_team
title: List team members
